name: Self Signal
prohibited_inferences: ["arithmetic/date/name mismatch","fixed-trait or destiny language","missing source or limitation"]
ai_role: explain deterministic result and draft sourced self-observation questions

name: Inner Architecture
prohibited_inferences: ["mind-reading or true-self claim","inferred event or motive","hidden contradiction"]
output_emphasis: ["tensions between stated values and roles","choice alternatives","confirm or reject prompts"]
ai_role: cluster only user-provided situations and draft alternatives

name: Behavior Code
prohibited_inferences: ["clinical label","pattern without sufficient observations","causal claim from correlation"]
ai_role: summarize patterns with denominator and time window

name: Work & Wealth
prohibited_inferences: ["investment/credit/employment decision","symbolic cycle as financial evidence","unstated assumption"]
ai_role: calculate typed scenarios and explain sensitivity

name: Relationship Field
required_inputs: ["each adult consent","mutually shared facts","self-reported agreements/conflicts","active grants"]
prohibited_inferences: ["loyalty or compatibility destiny claim","private content disclosure","coerced joint conclusion"]
ai_role: synthesize only mutually permitted sections while preserving speaker

name: Life Timeline
prohibited_inferences: ["invented event/date","lifespan prediction","symbolic and factual track merged"]
ai_role: normalize dates, detect conflicts and draft scenario branches

name: Body Intelligence
prohibited_inferences: ["disease/hormone/personality/morality inference","unapproved image/body input","missing DPIA or specialist gate"]
ai_role: summarize permitted diary only; baseline excludes image inference

name: Mission Path
prohibited_inferences: ["single destined mission","unsafe sacrifice pressure","capability without evidence"]
ai_role: connect evidence to alternatives and expose uncertainty

name: Full Life Code
required_inputs: ["released and consented L1–L8 components","explicit excluded/inapplicable components","current grants"]
ai_role: reconcile references without erasing disagreement and compress repetition
